text: Diagnostic code map: families LUMA/LUMD/LUMV/LUMB/LUME/LUMS, high-frequency codes with repairs, auto-recovery warnings (LUMD0260 narration skipped, LUMD0262 protected node kept, LUMD0263 reconcile summary).
A diagnostic is a contract … Never ignore one; never re-emit the exact token a diagnostic rejected. Repair from the failing line forward.
Repair re-declared an existing page → emit a continuation / modify line, or use structured ops — never re-page.
(Layout/fit codes) … instead of repeatedly shrinking unrelated text nodes. Do not re-author the scene.
One line: #slot:<key> image_policy(cover) — Do NOT delete the slot, and do not reach for asset(action="place").
